_doc: Budget for the storefront Worker (ebda-web, OpenNext), enforced by `scripts/ci/worker-startup-budget.mjs --app web` (CI: Worker dry-run (web)). Same method and caveats as worker-startup-budget.json (API): local-workerd numbers, regression gates with headroom, raise only with a Ruling. Bundle = cache-worker-entry.js (the generated entry the deploy uses). The absolute CPU ceiling runs on main/nightly; PRs compare against main built beside them (relative).
